title: RunPlan
description: The steps an agent intends to take, declared before it takes them. Carried in AG-UI shared state so the Portal can show work that has not happened yet.

status.description: A run never ends with a step left 'pending' - unreached steps become 'skipped', so the checklist cannot promise work that was not done.

tool.description: Optional hint: the tool that carries out this step. Lets the adapter advance the step when that tool fires, without the agent having to report progress explicitly.
